cards.title: Use genuine inventory scarcity without implying better product quality
cards.summary: Limited availability can increase desire to own a product without improving its functional value.
cards.use_when: Planning or reviewing an ecommerce offer, product page or campaign.
steps: Show scarcity only when backed by actual stock or a real offer deadline.
Keep fit, specifications and product evidence visible beside urgency messages.
Evaluate refunds and satisfaction alongside conversion.
caveats: Ecommerce adaptation of the source; test impact for this brand rather than assuming a universal lift.

cards.title: Separate competitive urgency from product fit in limited drops
cards.summary: Competition for a scarce item can rush decisions; a drop still needs a clear value proposition.
cards.use_when: Planning or reviewing an ecommerce offer, product page or campaign.
steps: Explain the product and allocation terms before the release.
Use actual demand and availability indicators rather than fabricated shopper counts.
Review complaints, returns and sell-through after the drop.
caveats: Ecommerce adaptation of the source; test impact for this brand rather than assuming a universal lift.

cards.title: Use verified shortcuts to simplify ecommerce purchase decisions
cards.summary: Shoppers under information load may rely on a few salient cues; those cues should accurately summarize relevant evidence.
cards.use_when: Planning or reviewing an ecommerce offer, product page or campaign.
steps: Identify the main buying question for the product category.
Choose a concise, supportable cue such as verified review patterns or a specific product specification.
Offer access to supporting details and test comprehension as well as conversion.
caveats: Ecommerce adaptation of the source; test impact for this brand rather than assuming a universal lift.

cards.title: Audit social-proof creative for fabricated evidence
cards.summary: Social proof becomes misleading when actors or staged reactions are presented as genuine customer experiences.
cards.use_when: Planning or reviewing an ecommerce offer, product page or campaign.
steps: Trace each testimonial or popularity claim to its actual evidence.
Label demonstrations and dramatizations appropriately instead of presenting them as spontaneous reviews.
Remove unsupported claims and compare revised creative performance.
caveats: Ecommerce adaptation of the source; test impact for this brand rather than assuming a universal lift.
